reviews.title: Great RAM Crisis Motherboard!  DDR4!
reviews.comment: Great motherboard!  If you're looking to do a slightly older build during the RAM crisis, this is your baby!  Three full size PCI-E slots and four DDR4 slots!  All the ASUS fan and RGB bells and whistles.  I installed an i5-12400F, zero issues!

reviews.title: A very nice budget board
reviews.comment: My previous motherboard, an Asus B150M was still going strong after almost 6 years but I wanted a Windows 11 capable system so I needed to upgrade.  I picked the DDR4 version of the B760M so I could use my existing RAM (4x4GB Kingston HyperX).  The swap was pretty straightforward with one hiccup.  For reasons that remain a mystery, the default TPM setting in the BIOS was hardware (discrete TPM) rather than firmware.  In this setting, it booted to an error screen (see picture) which said to run setup again.  Until I figured out what needed to be changed, it would not boot into Windows.  Once set to firmware TPM, it booted but I would still see this screen sometimes.  I did an online chat with Asus tech support and they suggested updating the BIOS (my board shipped with a December 2022 BIOS, latest is June 2023) which I did.  Too early to tell if that has fixed the problem permanently but so far it seems to have worked.
reviews.author: Lee

reviews.title: Good motherboard, limited expandability
reviews.comment: Good Motherboard, but has limited expandability since you only have 1 extra slot.  Using an Intel i9 14900K processor and benchmarks are very good.  I wished it had more m.2 slots on the board.  The description also say for 12th and 13th generation processors, with a quick update to the BIOS, my 14th Gen processor works perfectly.
